variants: manual whole-cell patch clamp (axopatch 200b)|manual whole-cell patch clamp
label_synonyms: manual patch clamp|conventional patch clamp|manual whole-cell patch clamp|manual whole cell recording|manual voltage clamp
definition: Whole-cell voltage or current clamp with a glass pipette, one cell at a time
notes: Standard secondary assay for ion channels; only the automated format has a term

variants: thallium flux (fluxor) fluorescence assay for potassium channels
definition: Tl+ influx through K+ channels read by a Tl-sensitive dye (FluxOR, FluxOR II)
notes: Entry IC2 already describes it; the term table has no technology term so campaigns cannot be labelled with it

variants: microscale thermophoresis (mst), nanotemper monolith|microscale thermophoresis (mst), nanotemper monolith nt.115|microscale thermophoresis (mst)|spectral shift / temperature-related intensity change (TRIC) affinity screening (NanoTemper Dianthus)
label_synonyms: microscale thermophoresis|micro-scale thermophoresis|thermophoresis|mst assay|mst analysis|mst method|mst measurement|mst based|monolith nt
definition: Binding affinity from ligand-induced change in thermophoretic movement of a labelled protein

proposed_term: Chromatographic separation of substrate and product (HPLC / HPTLC)
variants: hplc quantification of dht|hptlc (high-performance thin-layer chromatography) of testosterone and dht|hptlc of dht|hplc quantification of peptide cleavage products|hplc quantification of substrate depletion (uv-hplc)
definition: Product formed by the enzyme is separated and quantified by HPLC-UV or HPTLC, without MS detection
notes: Typical for steroid and lipid enzymes

variants: annexin v-fitc / propidium iodide, flow cytometry|imaging flow cytometry (imagestream)
definition: Per-cell fluorescence read on a flow cytometer (apoptosis, surface markers, reporter cells)
notes: Usually a phenotype readout; counts as target evidence only when the paper ties it to the target

variants: quenched activity-based probe (qabp) labelling with in-gel fluorescence|activity-based ubiquitin probe crosslinking (ub-avsn)|activity-based protein profiling (abpp) family-wide selectivity panel / dubome chemical proteomics
definition: Covalent probe labels the active enzyme; read by in-gel fluorescence, imaging or MS
notes: Common for cysteine proteases and serine hydrolases

variants: coupled-enzyme metabolite kit (acetyl-coa), fluorometric|coupled-enzyme fluorogenic probe (sqc with dt-diaphorase and d-lactate) reading d-lactate, the product of the glo1/glo2 pathway|coupled-enzyme fluorogenic probe (sqc with dt-diaphorase and d-ldh) reading d-lactate, the product of the glo1/glo2 pathway|coupled-enzyme amplex red / hrp peroxide detection (fluorescence)
definition: The product of the target enzyme is converted by helper enzymes into a colour or fluorescence signal (often a commercial metabolite kit)

variants: demethylation-activated fluorogenic dna aptamer (light-up aptamer)
definition: A nucleic-acid aptamer that fluoresces when it binds a dye; enzyme action switches it on or off

variants: liposome co-sedimentation with gfp fluorescence readout
definition: Protein binding to lipid vesicles measured by pelleting the liposomes and quantifying bound protein

variants: glosensor luminescent camp biosensor
label_synonyms: glosensor|glo sensor|glosensor camp|camp glosensor|glosensor 22f|glosensor camp reagent
definition: Live-cell luminescent cAMP biosensor (GloSensor-22F), read kinetically without lysis
notes: The standard GPCR cAMP format in recent papers; term table maps 'glosensor camp' only on the function axis

variants: genetically encoded fluorescent camp biosensor (pink flamindo)|genetically encoded fluorescent calcium biosensor (gcamp / rcamp)
definition: A fluorescent protein biosensor expressed in the cell reports a second messenger or analyte (Pink Flamindo, cADDis, Twitch)

variants: fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (frap)|fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (frap) of a reconstituted biomolecular condensate
definition: A region is bleached and recovery of fluorescence measures mobility, used to show a condensate is liquid

variants: in vitro phase separation (droplet formation) assay by confocal imaging|opto-droplet assay (cry2 optogenetic clustering in live cells)
definition: Condensate formation by the purified protein, or light-induced clustering in cells, scored by imaging droplet number and size
notes: With T012 and F001 this is a whole assay class the database has no entry for

variants: liquid-liquid phase separation / biomolecular condensate formation|biomolecular condensate formation / chromatin condensation and internal mobility (phase separation)
definition: The target's ability to form or dissolve biomolecular condensates
notes: Function axis; distinct from amyloid aggregation

variants: in vitro motility assay (fluorescent filament gliding on myosin)
definition: Fluorescent cytoskeletal filaments glide over a motor-coated surface and velocity is tracked

variants: pyrene-actin polymerization fluorescence assay
definition: Actin polymerization followed by the fluorescence increase of pyrene-labelled actin

variants: compound-bead affinity pull-down with lc-ms/ms identification (chemoproteomic target id)|biotinylated small-molecule affinity pull-down (streptavidin bead)|chemoproteomic competition pull-down (kinobeads-style affinity matrix)
definition: The compound immobilised on beads captures its targets from lysate, identified by LC-MS/MS, with free compound as competition
notes: How a target is identified for a phenotypic hit

variants: thromboelastometry (rotem) whole-blood clot viscoelasticity
definition: Viscoelastic clot formation and lysis in whole blood (ROTEM / TEG)
notes: Functional whole-blood assay for coagulation targets

variants: time-resolved fluorescence immunoassay (tr-fia / delfia europium sandwich)
definition: Heterogeneous europium-chelate sandwich immunoassay, read by time-resolved fluorescence; not a FRET assay

variants: two-electrode voltage clamp (tevc, xenopus oocytes)
definition: Current recording from a Xenopus oocyte expressing the channel using two impaling electrodes
notes: The standard first-pass electrophysiology for ligand-gated channel variants and modulators

variants: single-molecule fret (smfret)
definition: FRET between two dyes on one labelled molecule to follow conformational states one molecule at a time
notes: Reports conformational dynamics rather than an affinity

variants: beta-lactamase surface-expression reporter (nitrocefin)
definition: A beta-lactamase tag on the receptor ectodomain cleaves nitrocefin so surface and total receptor can be quantified in intact cells
notes: Used with F002 to separate a trafficking defect from a gating defect

variants: presto-tango beta-arrestin recruitment reporter
definition: Agonist binding brings arrestin-TEV to the receptor and releases a transcription factor that drives a luciferase reporter
notes: The standard arrestin format for GPCR deorphanisation and chemical screens

variants: bimolecular fluorescence complementation (bifc)|bimolecular fluorescence complementation (bifc), split fluorescent protein reassembly with bjun/bfos positive and bfos-deltazip negative controls
definition: Two halves of a fluorescent protein on two partners reconstitute fluorescence when the partners interact

variants: in situ proximity ligation assay (pla, duolink)|in situ proximity ligation assay (duolink detection reagents red)|in situ proximity ligation assay (duolink in situ red starter kit)|in situ proximity ligation assay (duolink, ligase + amplification polymerase, confocal)|in situ proximity ligation assay (duolink, antibody proximity + rolling-circle amplification, confocal foci)|in situ proximity ligation assay (duolink, antibody proximity + rolling-circle amplification, foci counted)
definition: Two antibodies within ligation distance generate a rolling-circle amplified fluorescent spot per interaction in fixed cells
notes: Endogenous-level interaction readout

variants: bioid proximity-dependent biotin labelling
definition: A promiscuous biotin ligase fused to the target biotinylates neighbours that are then captured and identified by MS

variants: proteome integral solubility alteration (pisa) assay
definition: Proteome-wide thermal solubility shift pooled across temperatures and read by quantitative MS
notes: Proteome-wide relative of CETSA

variants: isothermal dose-response fingerprint (itdrf) cetsa
definition: CETSA run at one temperature over a compound concentration series to give a cellular affinity

variants: biotinylated rna oligonucleotide pull-down (streptavidin bead)
definition: A biotinylated RNA bait on streptavidin beads captures binding proteins from lysate or purified protein
notes: The commonest RNA-protein binding assay in the RBP literature

variants: rna immunoprecipitation (rip) with rt-pcr readout
definition: The protein is immunoprecipitated and the bound RNA quantified by RT-qPCR

variants: eclip (enhanced crosslinking and immunoprecipitation) sequencing
definition: UV crosslinking and immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing to map the protein's binding sites transcriptome-wide

variants: chromatin immunoprecipitation with qpcr (chip-qpcr)
definition: Crosslinked chromatin is immunoprecipitated and occupancy at a locus measured by qPCR
notes: No ChIP term exists although Protein-DNA binding does

variants: stimulated raman scattering (srs) microscopy
definition: Label-free vibrational imaging that maps lipid and deuterated-metabolite content in single cells
notes: Used as a cellular readout of lipid desaturation

variants: shotgun lipidomics (direct-infusion ms)
definition: Direct-infusion MS quantification of lipid species against internal standards
notes: Carries the product-to-precursor readout for desaturases

variants: succinylated wheat germ agglutinin (swga) lectin enrichment of o-glcnacylated proteins
definition: Succinylated WGA beads capture O-GlcNAcylated proteins from lysate for immunoblot
notes: The cellular readout of OGT inhibition

variants: fluorescent cofactor (udp-glcnac) displacement assay
definition: A labelled cofactor analogue is displaced from the enzyme by a competing compound
notes: The HTS format behind the published OGT inhibitors

variants: dual-labeled protein conformational fluorescence quenching assay
definition: Two dyes on one protein report the open-to-closed transition by quenching, used to screen for ligands that shift the equilibrium

variants: hemin peroxidase (g-quadruplex) colorimetric assay
definition: A folded G-quadruplex binds hemin and acts as a peroxidase to turn over a colorimetric substrate

variants: proteoliposome reconstitution transport assay
definition: The purified transporter is reconstituted into liposomes and flux measured with an entrapped indicator dye
notes: The only cell-free functional assay available for many transporters

variants: mitochondrial swelling light-scattering assay
definition: Ion entry into isolated mitochondria is followed as a fall in light scattering

variants: mitochondrial membrane potential dye (tmrm)
definition: A cationic dye accumulating with mitochondrial potential; run alongside Ca2+ flux to show the driving force is intact
notes: The plasma-membrane term exists but not the mitochondrial one

variants: two-photon glutamate uncaging
definition: A caged agonist is released by a focused two-photon pulse to stimulate one synapse while imaging the response

variants: co-immunoprecipitation with western blot detection|his-tag ni-nta agarose pull-down
definition: The target is immunoprecipitated and the bound partner detected by immunoblot
notes: Very common; no term covers the interaction readout itself

variants: o-glcnac transferase (o-glcnacylation) activity
definition: Transfer of GlcNAc from UDP-GlcNAc to a serine or threonine of the substrate protein
notes: No glycosyltransferase function term exists

variants: pre-mrna splicing (minigene / splicing reporter)|bichromatic fluorescent splicing reporter (rg6) read by flow cytometry
definition: Inclusion or skipping of an exon from a minigene or endogenous transcript
notes: The central functional readout for splicing factors; nothing in the term table covers it

variants: cell-surface receptor expression / trafficking
definition: How much receptor reaches the plasma membrane
notes: Needed to interpret a variant's current amplitude

variants: ligand-induced conformational change (domain closure)
definition: Agonist-driven domain motion measured directly rather than through current or signal

variants: mitochondrial calcium retention capacity (crc)
definition: Sequential Ca2+ pulses until the permeability transition pore opens

variants: desaturase index (product-to-precursor fatty acid ratio)
definition: The ratio of the enzyme's fatty acid product to its precursor as a cellular activity measure
notes: The ENZ3 cellular-activity pattern for lipid enzymes

variants: adipocyte lipolysis assay (nefa release)
definition: Free fatty acid released from adipocytes as the functional readout of a Gi-coupled receptor

variants: crispr activation (dcas9-sam) gain-of-function screen
definition: A pooled dCas9-SAM library overexpresses each gene and survivors are sequenced
notes: The gain-of-function counterpart of the RNAi screen term

variants: drug affinity responsive target stability (darts) limited proteolysis|darts (drug affinity responsive target stability): ligand-induced protection from pronase limited proteolysis in cell lysate, read by immunoblot
definition: Ligand binding protects the target from a protease (usually pronase) in lysate; read by immunoblot. A label-free engagement assay that needs no heating, so it suits targets with no usable melting curve.

variants: acoustic ejection mass spectrometry (echo-ms / aems)
definition: Acoustic droplet ejection feeds samples straight into the mass spectrometer, giving label-free HTS at about one second per sample.

variants: thermal proteome profiling (tpp, proteome-wide cetsa by quantitative ms)
definition: CETSA run proteome-wide: melting curves for thousands of proteins by quantitative MS, used for target deconvolution rather than confirmation.

variants: fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy fret (flim-fret, tcspc)
definition: FRET measured as a shortening of the donor's fluorescence lifetime by time-correlated single-photon counting. Independent of expression level, so it suits receptor dimerisation in live cells.

variants: nanodsf label-free thermal unfolding (intrinsic tryptophan 350/330 ratio)
definition: Thermal unfolding followed by the 350/330 nm ratio of intrinsic tryptophan fluorescence, with no dye. Works where SYPRO Orange binds the protein or the compound.

variants: limited proteolysis stability assay (pepsin / proteinase k, sds-page timecourse)
definition: Timed digestion with pepsin or proteinase K, resolved by SDS-PAGE, to compare the folded stability of protein variants or binder scaffolds.

variants: yeast surface display binding titration
definition: Binders displayed on the yeast surface are titrated with labelled target and read by flow cytometry, giving a Kd without purifying the binder.

proposed_term: UV-vis difference spectroscopy of P450 heme binding
variants: uv-vis difference spectroscopy of p450 heme binding (type i / type ii spectral shift)
definition: A ligand entering the P450 active site shifts the heme Soret band; the type I or type II difference spectrum gives a spectral Ks and says whether the ligand coordinates the iron.

nearest_controlled_value: fluorogenic Vivid substrates with recombinant CYPs
variants: alkoxyresorufin o-dealkylase assay (mrod / erod, resorufin fluorescence)
definition: Classic CYP1-family activity assay: O-dealkylation of methoxy- or ethoxy-resorufin releases fluorescent resorufin.

variants: phosphosens sox chelation-enhanced fluorescence kinase peptide (continuous read)
definition: A sulfonamido-oxine peptide whose fluorescence rises on phosphorylation through Mg2+ chelation, giving a continuous real-time kinase read with no development step.

variants: kinase translocation reporter (nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling of a tagged substrate)
definition: A fluorescently tagged substrate (e.g. FOXO1 for AKT) moves between nucleus and cytoplasm with pathway activity; imaged and scored as a nuclear:cytoplasmic ratio.

variants: fluorescent cell barcoding phospho-flow cytometry in whole blood
definition: Samples are dye-barcoded and pooled, then stained for surface markers and phospho-epitopes, so a dose-response runs in one tube and per-cell-type potency comes out of whole blood.

variants: cfast: cellular fluorescence anisotropy readout of a thermal shift target-engagement assay
definition: Reads a thermal-shift engagement experiment by the anisotropy of a fluorescent tracer instead of by immunoblot, making CETSA plate-readable.

variants: sh3 domain capture assay for the open kinase conformation
definition: An immobilised SH3-binding peptide captures only the open, active conformation of a Src-family kinase from lysate, so it reports conformational state rather than abundance.

variants: fret-melting assay of a dual-labelled g-quadruplex (delta-tm)
definition: A dual-labelled oligonucleotide is melted in a real-time PCR instrument; the shift in melting temperature measures how strongly a compound stabilises the structure.

variants: dna polymerase stop assay (g-quadruplex-induced primer extension arrest)
definition: Primer extension stalls where a compound-stabilised secondary structure blocks the polymerase; the arrest site and intensity are read on a sequencing gel.

variants: cut&tag (cleavage under targets and tagmentation)
definition: Antibody-targeted Tn5 tagmentation maps where a protein or structure sits on chromatin, from far fewer cells than ChIP.

variants: trupath bret2 g-protein dissociation biosensor panel
definition: A matched set of Rluc8-Galpha / GFP2-Ggamma biosensors covering the G-protein family, so one receptor can be profiled for transducer coupling and bias.

proposed_term: Bimane fluorescence reporter of conformational change
variants: monobromobimane fluorescence quenching of a site-specific cysteine|arrestin c-tail release assay (bimane reporter)
definition: Bimane on an engineered cysteine reports its local environment; quenching or dequenching tracks a domain movement such as arrestin C-tail release.

variants: tandem ubiquitin binding entities (tube) pull-down of polyubiquitinated target
definition: High-avidity ubiquitin-binding domains capture polyubiquitinated protein from lysate, showing that a degrader works through ubiquitination rather than by lowering expression.

variants: automated capillary electrophoresis immunoassay (jess / wes simple western)
definition: Capillary electrophoresis plus in-capillary immunodetection: a quantitative, automated replacement for the blot, from very little lysate.

variants: dual-fluorescent-protein degradation reporter (gfp/mcherry ratio)
definition: The target is fused to GFP and expressed from the same transcript as mCherry; the GFP:mCherry ratio by flow cytometry normalises degradation against expression.

variants: spr a-b-a competition (buffer scouting) to localise the binding site
definition: An A-B-A injection series asks whether a compound and a known ligand compete, placing the compound at the orthosteric site or elsewhere.

variants: endothelial tube formation (in vitro angiogenesis)|endothelial spheroid sprouting|ex vivo aortic ring sprouting assay|chorioallantoic membrane (cam) angiogenesis assay
definition: The disease-relevant functional output for VEGFR2 and other angiogenesis targets: endothelial cells form tubes, spheroids sprout, aortic rings sprout ex vivo, or vessels grow on the chick CAM.

variants: ba/f3 cytokine-independence growth assay (il-3 withdrawal) for an oncogenic kinase
definition: Ba/F3 cells made dependent on a transfected oncogenic kinase by IL-3 withdrawal; growth inhibition with IL-3 present is the on-target control. The standard resistance-mutation panel for kinase inhibitors.

variants: single-cyp (mono-cyp) recombinant cell line for reaction phenotyping
definition: A cell line engineered to express one CYP plus its reductase, so a metabolite can be assigned to that isoform in a cellular rather than microsomal context.

variants: heparg hepatic cell model with enhanced cyp expression
definition: A hepatic line that differentiates to near-hepatocyte drug-metabolising capacity; used where primary hepatocytes are impractical, sometimes with a CYP boosted further.

variants: ipsc-derived liver organoid as the assay system
definition: A three-dimensional liver model from induced pluripotent stem cells, matured to a defined day and then assayed for drug metabolism like a monolayer.

nearest_controlled_value: LC-MS/MS of probe metabolites in human liver microsomes
variants: individual-donor human liver microsome panel (inter-individual variability)
definition: Microsomes from many single donors rather than one pool, so the result carries the spread between people as well as the mean.

proposed_term: Ex vivo PDX tumour cell sensitivity
variants: ex vivo drug sensitivity screening in freshly dissociated pdx tumour cells
definition: Freshly resected patient-derived xenograft tumour dissociated to single cells and dosed within hours, keeping the genotype that the model was selected for.

variants: ames bacterial reverse-mutation (genotoxicity) test
definition: Salmonella reversion test with and without S9 metabolic activation; the standard early genotoxicity gate.

variants: cipa comprehensive in vitro proarrhythmia assay panel
definition: Automated electrophysiology across hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2 and several other cardiac channels, replacing hERG alone as the proarrhythmia gate.

variants: cellular kinome-wide nanobret selectivity panel (128 kinases)
definition: Target engagement measured in live cells across roughly a hundred kinases, so selectivity is read at cellular ATP rather than in a biochemical assay.

variants: cyp reaction phenotyping with a recombinant isoform panel
definition: A compound is incubated with each recombinant CYP in turn to find which isoforms clear it, the companion of the inhibition panel.

variants: closed-loop automated design-make-test screening cycle
definition: Compound design, synthesis and assay run as one automated loop, with the assay feeding the next design round. Changes what the assay must deliver: speed and a continuous read matter more than ultimate precision.

variants: shrna knockdown target-validation control
definition: Knocking the target down should reproduce the compound's effect; the standard genetic control that an effect is on-target.

proposed_term: Cell-surface antigen binding by flow cytometry
variants: cell-surface antigen binding of a bispecific engager by flow cytometry
definition: A labelled biologic is titrated against antigen-positive and antigen-negative cells and read by flow cytometry, giving a cellular binding EC50 for an engager or antibody.

variants: streptavidin scintillant flashplate (scintillation proximity) detection
definition: Radiolabelled ligand bound to a scintillant-coated surface or bead gives signal only when close, so no wash step is needed
notes: from batch 4

variants: thioflavin-t (tht) fluorescence aggregation kinetics
definition: Thioflavin-T fluoresces on binding cross-beta amyloid structure, giving the lag/growth/plateau curve of fibril formation
notes: from batch 4

variants: chromatin retention assay (detergent pre-extraction then immunofluorescence)
definition: Soluble protein is washed out with detergent before fixation, so the remaining signal reports the chromatin-bound fraction; used to measure PARP trapping
notes: from batch 4

variants: adp-ribosylation mobility up-shift on sds-page with anti-adp-ribose detection
definition: Auto-modified protein runs as a smeared up-shifted band detected with anti-ADP-ribose or anti-PAR antibody
notes: from batch 4

variants: hoechst-sensitized 405 nm laser microirradiation with time-lapse recruitment kinetics at the irradiated line
definition: A focused laser makes a defined damage track in a sensitised nucleus and a fluorescently tagged protein's accumulation there is followed over time
notes: from batch 4

variants: immunocomplex of enzyme (ice) bioassay: caesium chloride density-gradient separation of protein-dna adducts, slot-blot immunodetection|immunocomplex of enzyme (ICE) bioassay|dust assay (dnazol recovery of nucleic acid, micrococcal nuclease digestion, immunodetection of dna-protein crosslinks with anti-dsdna loading control)
definition: Covalent protein-DNA adducts are separated from free protein (CsCl gradient in ICE, DNAzol recovery in DUST) and immunodetected; the standard cellular readout for topoisomerase cleavage-complex trapping
notes: from batch 4

variants: hibit lytic degradation assay reporting DC50 and Dmax|hibit live-cell kinetic degradation (endurazine continuous luminescence, one-phase exponential decay fit to Dmax and degradation half-life)
definition: An 11-amino-acid HiBiT tag on the endogenous or expressed target complements LgBiT to give luminescence proportional to protein level; the standard degrader readout, reported as DC50 and Dmax
notes: from batch 4

variants: protein lysine lactylation (lactyltransferase activity, lactyl-CoA as acyl donor, non-histone substrate)|protein lysine delactylation (NAD+-dependent sirtuin removal of lactyl marks)
definition: Transfer of a lactyl group from lactyl-CoA to a lysine side chain, and its NAD+-dependent sirtuin removal
notes: from batch 4

variants: protein arginine methyltransferase activity (non-histone substrate, SDMA readout)
definition: Symmetric or asymmetric dimethylation of an arginine on a substrate that is not a histone; the controlled vocabulary covers only the histone case
notes: from batch 4

variants: plasmid DNA relaxation assay (supercoiled to relaxed topoisomer mobility in agarose gel)
definition: Supercoiled plasmid is converted to relaxed topoisomers whose reduced gel mobility reports topoisomerase activity
notes: from batch 4

variants: topoisomerase DNA cleavage assay (nicked Form II resolved from supercoiled Form I)
definition: Trapped cleavage complexes are revealed as nicked or linear DNA resolved from supercoiled substrate; measures poisoning rather than catalytic inhibition
notes: from batch 4

variants: alkaline comet assay (single-cell gel electrophoresis, comet tail length by OpenComet)
definition: Single cells in agarose are lysed and electrophoresed; fragmented DNA migrates as a tail whose length measures strand breaks
notes: from batch 4

variants: lysosensor green dnd-189 lysosomal ph probe
definition: An acidotropic dye whose fluorescence reports lysosomal acidification, used alongside LC3/p62 to separate autophagic flux from blockade
notes: from batch 4

variants: radiolabelled substrate accumulation and efflux assay
definition: Uptake or retention of a radiolabelled transporter substrate measured by scintillation counting of cells or vesicles
notes: from batch 4

variants: vanadate-sensitive membrane atpase assay
definition: Phosphate release by an ABC transporter in a crude membrane vesicle preparation, with the orthovanadate-inhibited signal subtracted; the standard cell-free assay for P-glycoprotein
notes: from batch 4

variants: click-edu / proximity ligation assay to nascent dna (sirf-style protein-on-nascent-dna detection)
definition: Click chemistry on EdU-labelled nascent DNA plus proximity ligation to a protein antibody gives one focus per protein molecule at the replication fork
notes: from batch 4

variants: malachite green / picolorlock inorganic phosphate release detection
definition: Released inorganic phosphate forms a coloured complex with malachite green/molybdate, read by absorbance; the generic endpoint for ATPase, GTPase and phosphatase reactions
notes: from batch 4
